name: origin-erp
description: Origin ERP - integrated student management system (Express + Prisma API, React + Vite client)

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
